en.headline: Taxi driver arrested after crash injures family of three in Tai Po
en.dek: A 31-year-old driver was detained on suspicion of furious driving and driving while his licence was suspended after the vehicle hit a curb near Fu Heng Estate early Saturday.

zh.headline: 大埔的士失控撞路邊 三口家傷 司機涉危險駕駛及停牌期間駕駛被捕
zh.dek: 31歲姓陳司機清晨在富亨邨附近失控撞路邊，三名乘客受傷送院；司機涉嫌瘋狂駕駛及在停牌期間駕駛被扣查。

en.headline: Coleman Wong falls to Arthur Gea in Los Cabos semi-final
en.dek: The Hong Kong player lost 7-6, 6-3 to the French qualifier, ending his run at the ATP 250 event after reaching his first Tour semi-final and securing a top-100 ranking.

zh.headline: 黃澤林洛斯卡沃斯半決賽不敵法國新秀 止步四強
zh.dek: 港將直落兩盤輸給法國球員吉亞，結束ATP 250賽事征途；惟仍穩奪生涯首次入圍世界排名前100。

en.headline: Chief Executive to hold first district consultation in Tuen Mun on Sunday
en.dek: John Lee and principal officials will meet residents in small-group sessions to gather views on the 2026 Policy Address and Hong Kong's first five-year plan.

zh.headline: 李家超周日赴屯門舉行首場地區諮詢會 聽取施政報告意見
zh.dek: 行政長官與主要官員將以小組討論形式與市民交流，收集對2026年施政報告及首個五年規劃的意見。

en.headline: Huanggang Port to hold over 100 drills including stress tests with 10,000 people
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the exercises, some jointly with Shenzhen, will cover traffic, anti-terrorism and systems before the redeveloped checkpoint opens.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸通關前將進行逾百次演練 壓力測試涉逾萬人
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，演練包括與深圳方面聯合進行的跨境壓力測試，涵蓋交通、反恐及系統等，確保運作暢順安全後才決定開通日期。

en.headline: Debt servicing caps and referee ban for money lenders take effect
en.dek: First-phase measures prohibit lenders from requiring loan referees and set debt-servicing ratio limits of 35 to 40 per cent for unsecured personal loans to low-income earners.

zh.headline: 放債人規管措施首階段今日生效 設供款比率上限及禁止要求擔保人
zh.dek: 首階段措施禁止放債人要求借款人提供貸款擔保人，並為低收入人士無抵押私人貸款設定35%至40%的債務供款比率上限。

en.headline: Red flags raised at Big Wave Bay and Ting Kau beaches
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said water quality is forecast as very poor at the two beaches due to possible fluctuations after heavy rain.

zh.headline: 大浪灣及汀九泳灘懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示兩處泳灘水質預測指數為4屬非常差，因大雨可能導致短暫水質波動。

en.headline: Police seek information on missing 78-year-old man in Tsuen Wan
en.dek: Au Chun-cheong left his home on Lai King Hill Road on Friday afternoon and has not been seen since; officers issued a public appeal on Saturday.

zh.headline: 警方尋找荃灣失蹤78歲男子區振昌
zh.dek: 區振昌於星期五下午離開荔景山路住所後失蹤，警方星期六發出尋人呼籲。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning in force until 3pm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has issued a Thunderstorm Warning valid until 3 p.m., with thundery showers developing over southern and eastern areas.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至下午3時
zh.dek: 天文台發出雷暴警告，有效至今日下午3時，南部及東部有雷雨區逐漸發展。

en.headline: Coleman Wong reaches first ATP Tour semi-final and enters top 100
en.dek: The 22-year-old Hong Kong player defeated Jenson Brooksby in straight sets at the Los Cabos Open after earlier upsetting world No. 12 Jiri Lehecka.

zh.headline: 黃澤林首闖ATP巡迴賽四強 成港產男網首人入百強
zh.dek: 22歲港將於洛斯卡沃斯公開賽直落兩盤擊敗美國球員布碌士比，稍早亦爆冷淘汰世界排名第12的列赫卡。

en.headline: URA awards Hung Hom Bailey Street project to China Overseas for HK$6.9 billion
en.dek: Top Global Investment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Overseas Land & Investment, won the development contract after seven tenders were received.

zh.headline: 市建局紅磡庇利街項目批予中海 投標價69.02億元
zh.dek: 中國海外發展全資附屬公司偉國投資投得發展合約，共接獲七份標書。

en.headline: Provisional voter registers released with 64,900 new geographical electors
en.dek: The Registration and Electoral Office published the 2026 provisional registers and omissions lists; the public has until 25 August to check particulars or lodge claims.

zh.headline: 2026年臨時選民登記冊公布 地方選區新增約6.49萬人
zh.dek: 選舉事務處今日公布臨時選民登記冊及遭剔除者名單，市民可於8月25日前核對資料或提出申索及反對。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning extended until 9.30am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has kept the Thunderstorm Warning in force until 9.30 a.m., with isolated thunderstorms still expected over the territory this morning.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示雷暴警告繼續生效至上午9時30分，預期本港仍有局部地區出現雷暴。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning issued for Saturday morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has issued a Thunderstorm Warning valid until 7:45 a.m., with isolated thunderstorms expected across the territory.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至早上7時45分
zh.dek: 香港天文台於今早6時45分發出雷暴警告，有效至7時45分，預期本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Government tenders Kwun Tong site for EV fast charging and LPG station
en.dek: The 5,896-square-metre lot at Wai Lok Street will replace a dedicated LPG station and support the city's EV popularisation roadmap.

zh.headline: 政府招標出售觀塘和樂街地皮作電動車快速充電及石油氣站
zh.dek: 該幅5,896平方米地皮將重置專用石油氣加氣站，並配合電動車普及化路線圖。

en.headline: Public hospitals record 26 serious medication errors in first quarter
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said the figure rose more than 70 per cent from the previous quarter, with anticoagulants involved in 12 cases.

zh.headline: 公院首季錄26宗嚴重藥物錯誤事件
zh.dek: 醫管局指數字較上一季上升逾七成，其中12宗涉及抗凝血藥。

en.headline: High Court rejects mainland families' challenge to university fee rules
en.dek: Judge Russell Coleman ruled the Education Bureau's two-year residency requirement for subsidised places from 2028 is not irrational.

zh.headline: 高院駁回內地人才計劃家庭挑戰大學學費政策
zh.dek: 法官裁定教育局要求子女須居港至少兩年才可享資助學額的政策並非不合理，由2028年起生效。

en.headline: Overall crime falls 1.5 per cent in first half as phishing scams surge
en.dek: Police recorded 42,736 offences in the first six months of 2026, down 671 cases from a year earlier, while phishing fraud rose about 61 per cent.

zh.headline: 上半年整體罪案跌1.5% 釣魚騙案升約六成
zh.dek: 今年首六個月錄得42,736宗罪案，較去年同期減少671宗；釣魚騙案則上升約61%。

en.headline: Woman arrested over beauty parlour product containing undeclared controlled drugs
en.dek: The Department of Health and police acted against a Causeway Bay parlour after laboratory tests found a topical cream labelled Dermasa contained three local anaesthetics classified as Part 1 poisons.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣美容院售含未標示受管制藥物產品 女子被捕
zh.dek: 衞生署聯同警方採取行動，化驗顯示名為Dermasa的外用產品含有三種屬第1部毒藥的局部麻醉劑。

en.headline: Hong Kong GDP expands 4.3 per cent in second quarter
en.dek: Advance estimates show the economy grew for a 14th consecutive quarter, driven by strong merchandise exports, though seasonally adjusted growth slipped 0.6 per cent from the first quarter.

zh.headline: 本港第二季本地生產總值按年升4.3%
zh.dek: 政府公布初步估計，第二季經濟連續第14季擴張，貨品出口表現強勁，惟經季節性調整後按季下跌0.6%。

en.headline: Market Misconduct Tribunal finds Sir Dickson Poon culpable of insider dealing
en.dek: The tribunal ruled that the Dickson Concepts founder bought shares while in possession of inside information about a US$4 billion acquisition that later yielded the company about HK$1.15 billion in cash.

zh.headline: 市場失當行為審裁處裁定潘廸生爵士內幕交易罪成
zh.dek: 審裁處裁定廸生創建創辦人兼前集團執行主席在掌握有關一項最終為公司帶來約11.5億港元現金交易的內幕消息下，買入公司股份。

en.headline: Housing Society fined HK$8,000 over faulty fire alarm after fatal blaze
en.dek: The Hong Kong Housing Society pleaded guilty at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Court to failing to keep fire service installations in working order at Lotus Tower, where a man died in an October 2025 fire.

zh.headline: 房協火警警報故障罰款8000元 涉觀塘致命火警
zh.dek: 香港房屋協會於觀塘裁判法院承認一項未有保持消防裝置有效運作的控罪，該案涉及蓮花樓火警警報故障，去年10月有一名男子在火災中死亡。

en.headline: Police find insufficient evidence to charge basketball coach over student video
en.dek: Yung Kam-wah, a former Hong Kong national team player and Basketball Association vice-chairman, will not face prosecution after an investigation into a viral clip from a school training session.

zh.headline: 籃球教練迫學生掌摑案 警方指證據不足不檢控
zh.dek: 前港隊球員、籃總副主席翁金華涉校內訓練片段，警方完成深入調查後表示證據不足以起訴任何人。

en.headline: Senior police superintendent jailed nearly six months for indecent assault
en.dek: Ian Chow Ngai-kong was sentenced at West Kowloon Court after being convicted of assaulting a Civil Service Bureau clerk on three occasions at police headquarters in 2024.

zh.headline: 高級警司非禮文員判囚近六個月
zh.dek: 周艾剛於西九龍法院被判刑，早前裁定他在2024年於警察總部三次非禮一名公務員事務局文員罪名成立。

en.headline: Man arrested over suspected forged fire extinguisher certificate
en.dek: A 62-year-old contractor was arrested after investigators found severe corrosion on an extinguisher that had been certified as functional at a Lantau restaurant last year.

zh.headline: 疑虛報滅火筒檢查證書 62歲承辦商被捕
zh.dek: 消防處調查大嶼山食肆滅火筒爆炸後，發現承辦商去年發出的證書聲稱器材正常，惟其後發現嚴重銹蝕，懷疑未曾親身檢查。

en.headline: Authorities backtrack on mandatory fire escape hoods for hotels
en.dek: The Home Affairs Department will only encourage hotels and guest houses to provide sufficient smoke hoods in rooms, after industry concerns were raised following an earlier statement that they would be required.

zh.headline: 當局改為鼓勵酒店提供逃生頭套 不再強制規定
zh.dek: 民政事務總署回應業界關注後表示，只會鼓勵酒店及賓館在客房按最高住客量提供足夠煙霧頭套，不再強制要求。

en.headline: Super Typhoon Dolphin expected to bring very hot weather next week
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the storm’s outer subsiding airstream is likely to affect the southeastern China coast in the latter part of next week, though its later track remains uncertain.

zh.headline: 超強颱風海豚料下周後期為本港帶來酷熱天氣
zh.dek: 天文台指風暴外圍下沉氣流有較大機會影響華南沿岸，惟其後路徑仍有變數，現階段難料會否帶來暴雨。

en.headline: Mainland DSE candidates face 220 per cent entry fee rise to HK$8,000
en.dek: The Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority ends a three-year pilot subsidy, raising the initial fee for candidates sitting the diploma exam at designated mainland centres.

zh.headline: 內地考DSE初步報名費升220%至8000元
zh.dek: 考評局結束三年試驗計劃後調整費用，於指定內地試場應考文憑試的考生初步報名費將由2500元增至8000元。

en.headline: FEHD launches monthly allocation of over 1,600 public niches from tomorrow
en.dek: The enhanced arrangement replaces annual allocation and covers four columbaria; unsuccessful applicants for preferred sites will automatically be offered a niche at Tsang Tsui.

zh.headline: 食環署明日起每月編配逾1600個公眾骨灰龕位
zh.dek: 新安排全面取代周年編配，涵蓋四個靈灰安置所；未能獲選指定地點者將自動獲配曾咀龕位。

en.headline: Hong Kong Port Area at Huanggang established; Security Secretary inspects facilities
en.dek: The Hong Kong Port Area came under HKSAR jurisdiction from midnight; Tang Ping-keung inspected the co-location facilities and chaired a cross-departmental meeting on readiness.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸港方口岸區今日零時成立 鄧炳強視察並主持跨部門會議
zh.dek: 港方口岸區由今日零時起由特區依法管轄；保安局局長鄧炳強下午視察聯檢大樓設施，並主持跨部門會議推進開通前準備工作。

en.headline: Labour Department gazettes addenda to scaffolding safety codes
en.dek: Revised guidance on bamboo and metal scaffolding, including stronger toe-board and fire-retardant requirements, takes immediate effect after publication in the Gazette.

zh.headline: 勞工處刊憲棚架安全守則增編即日生效
zh.dek: 《竹棚架工作安全守則》及《金屬棚架工作安全守則》增編今日刊憲即日生效，加強底護板強度及保護幕阻燃要求。

en.headline: Red rainstorm warning issued; afternoon school classes cancelled
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the red rainstorm signal at 11.05 am on Friday; the Education Bureau said students of PM schools need not attend classes this afternoon.

zh.headline: 紅色暴雨警告生效 教育局：下午校學生今日無需上課
zh.dek: 天文台於上午11時05分發出紅色暴雨警告信號；教育局宣布下午校學生今日無需上課，學校須繼續開放照顧已到校學生。

en.headline: Tsim Sha Tsui bar assault victim dies, police reclassify case as murder
en.dek: A 32-year-old man died early on Friday after the 26 July attack at an upstairs bar; police have reclassified the case as murder, made two further arrests and will charge one man with murder.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧傷人案受害人不治 警方改列謀殺案
zh.dek: 32歲男子於7月26日在尖沙咀樓上酒吧遇襲後，今晨不治；警方將案件改列謀殺，再拘兩人，其中一人將被控謀殺罪。

en.headline: Advance Decision on Life-sustaining Treatment Ordinance takes effect
en.dek: The new law provides a legal framework for advance medical directives and do-not-attempt CPR orders, offering protection for patients’ wishes and for medical staff who follow them.

zh.headline: 《維持生命治療的預作決定條例》今日生效
zh.dek: 新法例為預設醫療指示及不作心肺復甦術命令提供法律框架，保障病人意願及遵從指示的醫護人員。

en.headline: Motorcyclist dies after Tolo Highway crash in Tai Po
en.dek: A 39-year-old man was certified dead after his motorcycle fell and was struck by a private car on Thursday evening; the car driver has been arrested for dangerous driving causing death.

zh.headline: 大埔吐露港公路電單車車禍 男司機死亡
zh.dek: 一名39歲男子星期四晚騎電單車在吐露港公路失控跌倒，再被私家車輾過，其後證實死亡；私家車司機涉嫌危險駕駛導致他人死亡被捕。

en.headline: Transport Department orders probe after truck crash snarls airport link
en.dek: A medium goods vehicle overturned on Cheung Tsing Highway in Tsing Yi during the Thursday evening rush hour, causing more than three hours of gridlock on the route to the airport.

zh.headline: 長青公路貨車翻側堵塞機場通道 運輸署要求調查
zh.dek: 一輛中型貨車星期四晚在青衣長青公路翻側，導致往機場方向交通癱瘓逾三小時，運輸署已要求青馬管制區營辦商提交報告。

en.headline: No. 3 alarm fire breaks out at Mai Po warehouse
en.dek: Firefighters used three jets and breathing apparatus teams after the blaze at Luk Mei Tsuen was upgraded early on Friday; no casualties have been reported.

zh.headline: 米埔倉庫三級火 消防出動三條喉及煙帽隊
zh.dek: 元朗米埔綠美村倉庫凌晨起火，約四時半升為三級火，消防以三條喉及煙帽隊灌救，暫未有人受傷。

en.headline: FEHD issues vermin notice to Langham Place after rat video
en.dek: The department ordered the Mong Kok shopping centre's management to eliminate conditions conducive to rodents by 6 August or face possible prosecution.

zh.headline: 食環署向朗豪坊發消除蟲鼠通知 限期8月6日前改善
zh.dek: 旺角朗豪坊有影片顯示老鼠沿扶手奔跑，食環署巡查後發現鼠跡及天花孔洞，向管理方發出法定通知，否則可被檢控。

en.headline: Youth suicides hit near 10-year high in 2025, NGO says
en.dek: Samaritan Befrienders Hong Kong reported 47 deaths among those aged 19 or under last year, up more than 30 per cent, while the overall suicide rate fell.

zh.headline: 2025年青少年自殺數字近十年最高
zh.dek: 撒瑪利亞會指19歲或以下自殺死亡個案增至47宗，升逾三成，惟整體自殺率下跌。

en.headline: Red Cross map shows northern districts face highest disaster risk
en.dek: A new Hong Kong Red Cross study finds 14.7 per cent of the territory is at extreme risk from typhoons, extreme heat or fires, with Yuen Long and North District the most exposed.

zh.headline: 紅十字會災害風險地圖 元朗北區風險最高
zh.dek: 香港紅十字會研究顯示全港近15%地區屬極端災害風險，元朗及北區最集中，超過一半地區同時面對兩種或以上高風險。

en.headline: Three former HSBC staff charged with bribery over account openings
en.dek: The ICAC alleges the relationship managers at a Causeway Bay branch accepted payments in 2024 to help customers referred by an insurance agent jump the queue.

zh.headline: 三名前匯豐職員涉收賄協助開戶被控
zh.dek: 廉署指三人於銅鑼灣分行任職關係經理期間，在2024年收受利益協助保險代理轉介客戶免排隊開立銀行帳戶。

en.headline: FEHD closes To Kwa Wan Market stall after vibrio cholera found in fish tank
en.dek: A water sample taken on 24 July from stall F22 on the first floor of the market at 165 Ma Tau Wai Road tested positive; the stall remains closed for thorough disinfection.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣街市魚缸水驗出霍亂弧菌 食環署封閉檔位
zh.dek: 馬頭圍道165號土瓜灣街市一樓F22號檔位7月24日抽取的魚缸水樣本驗出O1群霍亂弧菌，檔位已即時暫時封閉徹底清潔消毒。

en.headline: Customs seizes 18 kg ketamine and 3 kg cannabis at airport, arrests two
en.dek: A local woman arriving from Zurich and a Malaysian man from Bangkok were stopped with the drugs hidden in check-in luggage; the haul is valued at about HK$7.9 million.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲18公斤氯胺酮及3公斤大麻花 拘兩人
zh.dek: 一名由蘇黎世抵港的本地女子及一名由曼谷抵港的馬來西亞男子，在託運行李藏毒被截獲，估計總市值約790萬元。

en.headline: Water supply restored to Tuen Mun estates after two-day repairs
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said supply gradually resumed from 6 pm on Thursday to estates including Yi Fung Court, Hin Fat Estate, Hang Shun Garden and Koon Fung Garden after further leak repairs.

zh.headline: 屯門多個屋苑傍晚起陸續恢復食水供應
zh.dek: 水務署表示，經過兩日搶修富發里及屯興路水管漏點後，怡峰園、顯發邨、恒順園及冠峰園等屋苑星期四傍晚六時起陸續恢復供水。

en.headline: Six injured after truck and minibus collide on Castle Peak Road
en.dek: A heavy goods vehicle and a green minibus collided on the Yuen Long-bound section of Castle Peak Road–Tam Mi near Po Wai around 4.30 pm, leaving six people with neck injuries.

zh.headline: 青山公路潭尾段貨車小巴相撞六人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛重型貨車與一輛專線小巴星期四下午約四時半在元朗青山公路潭尾段近壆圍相撞，六人頸部受傷送往博愛醫院。

en.headline: Chief Executive concludes advisers' talks on first five-year plan
en.dek: John Lee held three days of working luncheons with the Chief Executive's Council of Advisers to gather views on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.

zh.headline: 李家超與特首顧問團完成三年規劃及施政報告交流
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超一連三日與特首顧問團舉行工作午餐，聽取對香港第一個五年規劃及2026年施政報告的意見。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Korean police sign MOU to fight cross-border crime
en.dek: The Hong Kong Police Force and the Korean National Police Agency signed a memorandum of understanding in Seoul on 29 July to deepen cooperation on drugs, human trafficking, cybercrime and training.

zh.headline: 港警與韓國警察廳簽署合作備忘錄 打擊跨境罪案
zh.dek: 香港警務處與韓國警察廳7月29日在首爾簽署合作備忘錄，加強打擊跨境罪案及專業培訓合作，涵蓋毒品、人口販運、網絡罪案及情報交流。

en.headline: Former hospital doctor given community service for misappropriating drugs
en.dek: Lee Chi-leung, a former associate consultant at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, was sentenced to 160 hours of community service and ordered to pay HK$20,000 after being found guilty of misconduct in public office.

zh.headline: 前伊院醫生公職人員行為失當 判160小時社會服務令
zh.dek: 前伊利沙伯醫院副顧問醫生李志良因公職人員行為失當，被判160小時社會服務令及向醫管局賠償2萬元，涉及以虛假預約及過量處方方式取得咳藥水及治療專注力不足藥物。

en.headline: Taiwanese man jailed 12 years and four months for cocaine trafficking
en.dek: High Court Judge Wilson Chan sentenced Miao Chi-hung on his final working day after the defendant admitted bringing 890 grams of cocaine into Hong Kong in wine bottles in 2019.

zh.headline: 台灣男子運毒判囚12年4個月 為法官陳嘉信最後一案
zh.dek: 高等法院法官陳嘉信星期四判處台灣男子苗志鴻監禁12年4個月，被告承認2019年以紅酒樽藏有890克可卡因入境，為法官提早退休前最後一次公開聆訊。

en.headline: Two-month LPG fuel subsidy for taxis and minibuses ends tonight
en.dek: The temporary 50-cent-per-litre rebate for liquefied petroleum gas used by taxis, public light buses and school private light buses expires at 11.59 pm, after which drivers will pay full pump prices.

zh.headline: 的士小巴石油氣補貼今晚屆滿
zh.dek: 為期兩個月、每公升0.5元的臨時石油氣燃料補貼將於今晚11時59分結束，受惠車輛其後須按油公司牌價全數付款。

en.headline: Security guard jailed four months for dumping resident's cat in rubbish bin
en.dek: Chau Wing-lok, 62, admitted one count of animal cruelty at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts after placing a lost cat in a plastic bag and discarding it at Lee Kee Building in Ngau Tau Kok last August.

zh.headline: 牛頭角保安員將走失貓丟入垃圾桶判囚四個月
zh.dek: 62歲周姓保安員承認一項殘酷對待動物罪，於九龍城裁判法院被判即時入獄四個月，案涉去年8月在利基大廈將走失家貓裝袋棄置。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Shenzhen sign colocation arrangement for Huanggang Port
en.dek: Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung and a Shenzhen vice-mayor signed the co-operation arrangement and right-to-use agreement, bringing the Hong Kong Port Area under HKSAR jurisdiction from midnight.

zh.headline: 港深簽署皇崗口岸「一地兩檢」合作安排
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強與深圳市副市長今日在中環政府總部簽署合作安排及使用權協議，香港口岸區將於明日零時起由特區依法管轄。

en.headline: HKMA keeps base rate at 4 per cent after Fed holds rates steady
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the Federal Reserve’s decision to leave the federal funds target range unchanged was in line with market expectations and local markets continued to operate orderly.

zh.headline: 金管局維持基本利率4厘 緊隨聯儲局按兵不動
zh.dek: 金管局表示聯儲局維持聯邦基金利率目標範圍的決定符合市場預期，本港貨幣及金融市場繼續有序運作。

en.headline: Zhongji Innolight shares fall on debut after HK$53.4 billion Hong Kong listing
en.dek: The Chinese optical-parts maker raised HK$53.41 billion in what became Hong Kong’s largest share sale this year; shares opened below the offer price of HK$980.

zh.headline: 中際旭創港股上市集資534億元 首日股價低開
zh.dek: 中國光學零件製造商完成今年本港最大型新股上市，發行價980港元，股份今早低於發行價開出。

en.headline: Customs seizes 36 kg ketamine and 21 kg cannabis at airport, arrests four
en.dek: Two British nationals, a Malaysian man and a local woman were stopped after officers found the drugs in check-in luggage on flights from London and Bangkok; one faces court today.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲36公斤氯胺酮及21公斤大麻花 拘四人
zh.dek: 兩名英國籍旅客、一名馬來西亞男子及一名本地女子在倫敦及曼谷航班行李中被發現毒品，其中一人今日提堂。

en.headline: 38 arrested in New Territories South anti-illegal worker operation
en.dek: Police and Immigration Department officers raided multiple locations under Operation CHAMPION on Wednesday; those arrested face offences including illegal entry and breach of stay conditions.

zh.headline: 新界南反非法勞工行動拘38人
zh.dek: 警方聯同入境處星期三在新界南多處進行「冠軍」行動，被捕人士涉嫌非法入境及違反逗留條件等。

en.headline: Box truck overturns on Cheung Ching Road after colliding with van
en.dek: The accident near the Shell oil depot in Tsing Yi blocked multiple lanes and caused heavy congestion on routes towards the airport on Wednesday evening.

zh.headline: 青衣長青公路貨櫃車與客貨車相撞翻側
zh.dek: 星期三傍晚近蜆殼油庫位置發生車禍，多條行車線受阻，往機場方向交通嚴重擠塞。

en.headline: Research Grants Council awards record HK$478 million to 12 university projects
en.dek: More than one-third of the supported proposals under the Areas of Excellence and Theme-based Research schemes involve artificial intelligence applications.

zh.headline: 研資局撥款約4.78億元支持12個大學研究項目
zh.dek: 卓越學科領域計劃及主題研究計劃合共支持破紀錄12個項目，逾三分之一涉及人工智能應用。

en.headline: Police warn of AI voice scams after 150 WhatsApp hijackings cause HK$26 million losses
en.dek: In the past two weeks scammers have used artificial intelligence to imitate the voices of hijacked account holders’ relatives; one victim lost HK$10 million.

zh.headline: 警誡WhatsApp被盜用後AI語音詐騙 兩周150宗損失逾2600萬
zh.dek: 騙徒在過去兩周利用人工智能模仿被盜帳戶親友聲音，其中一宗受害人損失1000萬元。

en.headline: Seven arrested over Tsim Sha Tsui bar assault that left man in critical condition
en.dek: Police say the 32-year-old victim suffered severe head injuries and a fractured rib; some of those arrested are suspected of having triad links and further arrests are not ruled out.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧傷人案七人被捕 傷者情況危殆
zh.dek: 警方指32歲男傷者頭部嚴重受傷及肋骨骨折，部分被捕人士涉嫌有黑社會背景，不排除再有人被捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes 225,000 electronic chips worth HK$6.25 million at Shenzhen Bay
en.dek: Two men were arrested after officers intercepted an outbound private car and found the suspected unmanifested cargo in the boot; they face court today.

zh.headline: 海關深圳灣檢獲22.5萬枚電子芯片 估值625萬元
zh.dek: 關員截查一輛出境私家車，在車尾箱發現懷疑未列艙單貨物；兩名男子被控意圖輸出未列艙單貨物，今早在屯門裁判法院應訊。

en.headline: Mainland visitor wounded in Mong Kok early-morning attack
en.dek: A 35-year-old man was injured in the neck at a building on Argyle Street around 2 am; police classify the case as wounding and are seeking a suspect.

zh.headline: 旺角凌晨傷人案內地男頸部受傷
zh.dek: 35歲男子約凌晨2時在亞皆老街大廈內頸部受傷，清醒送院；警方列傷人案調查，正通緝一名疑犯。

en.headline: FEHD arrests 14 unlicensed hawkers and seizes nearly 600 kg of food
en.dek: An intelligence-led citywide operation that began on 17 July targeted high-risk locations; suspects aged 38 to 74 face charges including obstruction and selling restricted food.

zh.headline: 食環署拘14名無牌小販檢獲近600公斤食品
zh.dek: 由7月17日起展開的情報主導全港行動針對高風險地點，涉案者年齡38至74歲，大部分另被控阻街，兩人兼控售賣限制售賣食物。

en.headline: CFS finds no excessive lead in over 50 infant formula samples
en.dek: All samples tested between 25 and 28 July, including 11 batches of one brand previously linked to a Macau alert, met Hong Kong’s legal limit of 0.01 mg per kg.

zh.headline: 食安中心抽檢逾50個嬰幼兒奶粉樣本全部鉛含量合格
zh.dek: 7月25至28日抽取的樣本（包括11個曾與澳門通報有關的品牌批次）鉛含量均未超出本港法定上限每公斤0.01毫克。

en.headline: Doctor cleared of misconduct over 2010 laser eye surgeries after 15 years
en.dek: The Medical Council offered no evidence against ophthalmologist Yiu Man-kit on three disciplinary charges linked to Lasik procedures and follow-up treatment.

zh.headline: 眼科醫生涉2010年激光手術專業失德指控不成立
zh.dek: 醫務委員會秘書未有就三項紀律指控提證，眼科醫生姚文傑在事隔15年後獲裁定專業失德不成立。
